name: Chart - Crop Profitability
query:
WITH
    -- Step 1: Calculate Total Revenue per Crop Cycle
    RevenueData AS (
        SELECT
            summary.parent AS crop_cycle,
            SUM(IFNULL(hl.total_weight_gross, 0) * IFNULL(ip.price_list_rate, 0)) AS total_revenue
        FROM `tabCrop Cycle Harvest Summary` AS summary
        JOIN `tabHarvest Log` AS hl ON summary.harvest_log = hl.name
        JOIN `tabHarvest Log Item` AS hli ON hli.parent = hl.name
        LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` AS ip ON hli.item_code = ip.item_code AND ip.selling = 1
        GROUP BY summary.parent
    ),

    -- Step 2: Calculate Total Costs per Crop Cycle
    CostData AS (
        SELECT
            cc.name AS crop_cycle,
            (
                ( -- Dosing Costs
                    SELECT IFNULL(SUM(dli.quantity_used * i.standard_rate), 0)
                    FROM `tabDosing Log Item` AS dli
                    JOIN `tabDosing Log` AS dl ON dli.parent = dl.name
                    JOIN `tabItem` AS i ON dli.item = i.name
                    WHERE dl.crop_cycle = cc.name AND dl.docstatus = 1
                )
                +
                ( -- Sanitization Costs
                    SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sc.quantity_used * i.standard_rate), 0)
                    FROM `tabSanitization Chemical` AS sc
                    JOIN `tabSanitization Log` AS sl ON sc.parent = sl.name
                    JOIN `tabItem` AS i ON sc.sanitizing_agent = i.name
                    WHERE sl.hydroponic_system = cc.hydroponic_system AND sl.docstatus = 1 AND sl.sanitization_date BETWEEN cc.start_date AND cc.end_date
                )
                +
                ( -- Other Expenses
                    SELECT IFNULL(SUM(el.amount), 0)
                    FROM `tabExpense Log` AS el
                    WHERE el.crop_cycle = cc.name AND el.docstatus = 1
                )
            ) AS total_cost
        FROM `tabCrop Cycle` AS cc
        WHERE cc.docstatus = 1
    )

-- Final Step: Join the revenue and cost data
SELECT
    cc.name AS "Crop Cycle",
    cc.crop AS "Crop",
    (IFNULL(rev.total_revenue, 0) - IFNULL(costs.total_cost, 0)) AS "Net Profit"
FROM
    `tabCrop Cycle` AS cc
LEFT JOIN RevenueData AS rev ON cc.name = rev.crop_cycle
LEFT JOIN CostData AS costs ON cc.name = costs.crop_cycle
WHERE
    cc.docstatus = 1
    -- This part allows your 'growth_method' filter to work
    AND (cc.growth_method = %(growth_method)s OR %(growth_method)s IS NULL OR %(growth_method)s = '')
